select tdd.id, tdd.template_id, tdd.docs_name, tdd.create_time, tdd.update_time, tdd.task_id, pte.status as templateStatus from template_delivery_docs tdd left join project_template pte on tdd.template_id = pte.id
and tdd.docs_name like concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword} ,'%')
and tdd.template_id like concat('%', #{params.templateId} ,'%')
ORDER BY tdd.create_time DESC
